section: Missouri corporate income and franchise taxes: figures under review
label: Corporate income tax rate
note: Flat 4% of Missouri taxable income. A 2025 bill to phase it out (HCS HB 425) was not enacted; no 2026 rate change was found.
source_title: Missouri House of Representatives: Bill summary, HCS HB 425 (2025), Corporate Income Taxes (PDF)

label: Levied by
value: Counties and other political subdivisions (cities, towns, villages, townships, school, road and other districts); the State may levy a small tax
source_title: Missouri Secretary of State: Constitution of the State of Missouri (PDF), Article X

label: State oversight
value: State Tax Commission of Missouri (constitutional equalization commission)
note: Equalizes assessments between counties and hears assessment appeals. Its website (stc.mo.gov) refused automated access, so the constitution is cited.
source_title: Missouri Secretary of State: Constitution of the State of Missouri (PDF), Article X, Section 14

label: Maximum local tax rates
value: Municipalities $1.00 per $100 assessed value; counties 35 or 50 cents per $100 (plus separate limits for school districts and road levies)
note: Constitutional caps, which voters can raise for limited periods.
source_title: Missouri Secretary of State: Constitution of the State of Missouri (PDF), Article X, Section 11(b)

label: State property tax limit
value: State tax on real and tangible personal property capped at 10 cents per $100 of assessed value
note: Excludes any tax needed to pay state bonded debt.
source_title: Missouri Secretary of State: Constitution of the State of Missouri (PDF), Article X, Section 8

label: Real estate transfer tax
value: None: the Missouri Constitution bars the State, counties and other local governments from imposing any new tax on the sale or transfer of real estate
source_title: Missouri Secretary of State: Constitution of the State of Missouri (PDF), Article X, Section 25
